department: Department of Marine and Environmental Sciences (College of Science)

deadline.value: Priority deadline December 1; rolling admission until March 15 if places remain.
deadline.quote: Priority deadline: December 1 | Rolling deadline: March 15

gre_general.value: The General GRE is not required and is not considered in review.
gre_general.quote: Marine and Environmental Sciences: GRE General Test NOT required and NOT considered in the review process

funding.value: All admitted PhD students receive a full tuition scholarship, a stipend-paying graduate assistantship and health insurance for the duration of the program.
funding.quote: For the duration of their program, students receive full tuition scholarship, a graduate assistant position with stipend, and health insurance.

english_waiver.value: A degree earned or in progress at an institution where English is the only medium of instruction counts as proof of English proficiency in the College of Science.
english_waiver.quote: Proof of English Proficiency is required for all applicants and for all programs (from one of the following): | Degree earned or in progress at an institution where English is the only medium of instruction

supervisor.value: Contacting a prospective faculty advisor is a required step in the application.
supervisor.quote: Establishing a connection with a prospective faculty advisor is a required step in the application process.

entry_route.value: The PhD has a Bachelor's Degree Entrance track, so you can apply with a bachelor's degree.
entry_route.quote: Bachelor’s Degree Entrance | Complete all courses and requirements listed here unless otherwise indicated.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: Covers marine sciences, geosciences, sustainability sciences, and ecology and evolutionary biology. The College of Science also runs Biophysics, Psychology and Human Behavior and Sustainability Sciences PhDs, not saved as separate fields.
